reviews.x: I like that it is easy to put the hair band on and that there are compartments to put loose hair clips. I don't like that the compartments do not screw together to prevent from falling off if tipped over. Each part sits on top of one another and if it falls, all the contents fall out. This product must be put in a safe spot so it is knocked over.

[[VIDEOID:e042bc7eddf48e2be2fe0dfa6f8b2c2]] I don’t think I could recommend this product enough! It holds many headbands (I think I have about 18 here, front and back) and can fit many scrunchies and hair ties inside the container. I looked around before settling on this holder and I’m so glad I did!

I love how handy this is for all my hair accessories! It fits everything! I also have hairclips inside but you can't tell in the picture I provided because of all my headbands. No flaws found, which I'm happy about! There are 2 compartments and you can add little clips or hair ties on the top without having them to fall off and for easy access. Would definitely purchase again!

This product is amazing! I love that it has separate compartments on the inside that can be taken apart for my scrunchies and other miscellaneous hair ties! Plus it looks so organized with all my headbands in one place and not stuffed in a door. If you’re a headband lover like me I’d recommend this product, good quality for price and makes your bathroom counter organized and cute.

reviews.t: Great for tidying up hair accessories!!
reviews.x: This thing is awesome!!  Has really helped with space in storing headbands and ponytail holders.  My daughters have a ridiculous amount of both, so this has helped keep their bathroom counter and drawers tidy.

My two daughters only wear headbands, as a result we have about 50 headbands in our house that are constantly everywhere. I got so sick of the mess so I bought two of these. I felt like a fool spending $30 on headband holders but I am so glad I did (I still think they are a little expensive though...)  I put about 12 headbands on the canister (some thicker than others) and they fit really well. What I didn't realize prior to purchasing is that there are two sections inside, the top one is shallo
I love this thing, it helps keep my rubber bands, hair clips, and other accessories all in one spot. I keep the smaller items and the top container in the larger items in the bottom container.
I was very excited to receive this product but at the end I received a totally different one. Very disappointing. I will return it.
I was very excited to receive this product but at the end I received a totally different one. Very disappointing. I will return it.

reviews.t: Good for keeping hair accessories neat
reviews.x: Great for storing all of my daughter's bows, hair ties, and clips inside. The outside holds almost all of her headbands.

reviews.t: Would be great if it didn't come chipped!!
reviews.x: I bought this for my daughter's headbands. It doesn't fit many headbands of they're thick or have big bows on them. The storage on the inside is nice. The fact that it's clear will match anything as well. I would have given 5 stars except it came chipped on the bottom. It had to have been broken before being sent because the other piece wasn't in the bag it came in.

reviews.t: I'm still happy with the keeping everything in one place
reviews.x: Stores several headbands with big bows, flowers etc on them. However, my 5 yo has trouble with knocking them off when she wants to get the contents of the inner storage containers. I'm still happy with the keeping everything in one place. Headbands can create a lot of clutter when not contained. This helps a great deal.

reviews.t: Arrived broken and Smaller than expected
reviews.x: Mine came broken.  It’s still usable, but a big chip of the plastic was broken off on the bottom.  Also, this is smaller than I expected.  If you have headbands that have bows or flowers on them, you can expect to only fit maybe 5 or 6 on here without crumpling the decorative part of the headband.

Perfect for my daughter's headbands! We don't use the interior of the container because she has so many headbands on it that it would be hard to take apart and put together all the time. (It opens easily when they aren't on there.) You also can't see what's inside with that many headbands anyway.

I have been fighting with my daughter for YEARS on how to keep her headbands organized and in one place. This is exactly what I've always been needing. I love that the inside allows you to store your scrunchies, clips, and hair ties. I wish we had this years ago

reviews.t: This is for my girls that love headbands
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:8b2d6c839a4a5778424225ff4b9ac205]] This headband holder is the bomb it has two compartments that can hold extra bobby-pins ponytail holders etc. And even more headbands it’s a must especially if you have a lot of them like me😊 Plus it only cost 19.99

I looked everywhere trying to find something to hold all of my daughter's hair elastics and scrunchies! This is perfect and my 7 year old daughter loves it! So nice to have a place to hold all of this without finding things all over the house!
This product is pretty and the perfect size! However. The stackable element doesn't click tight so it keeps unstacking when we take headbands on and off. Thats disapointing...

reviews.t: I purchased 3 of these as they all place nicely all my daughts clips bows and everything she likes ...
reviews.x: I purchased 3 of these as they all place nicely all my daughts clips bows and everything she likes to put in her hair including her head bands!
This was broken within a few weeks of having it. The pieces also never stayed together. They were always falling off.

Wish this was taller. I had to get 2 for my headbands but they look so much nicer

I waa so excited for this!  My daughter was down with it too!  I'm tired of not being able to find any of her milliom headbands, bows, or scrunchies.  But it arrived broken...  We filled it real quick to make sure it was going to work. And it's perfect!  But now we're sending it back, and they're out of stock...  :(  i normally only get things that arrive in a couple days, but, it seemed so perfect for what we needed I got it anyways even with a slow delivery date...  I'm disappointed for sure.

i don't have a ton of headbands but they are so weird to store so this is perfect for what i was wanting. i will say, if i had a ton then this wouldn't be that useful. thicker headbands are trendy right now and it really doesn't hold too many of those so keep that in mind. the compartments are cool but i only use the top one because it is the easiest to get to. The whole thing comes apart in a couple sections to store things inside of it too

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product for keeping headbands and hair accessories organized and tidy in one place.
Many reviewers like the interior compartments for storing scrunchies, clips, and hair ties.
Some reviewers report the product arrived broken or chipped.
A few reviewers note it holds fewer headbands than expected, especially thick or decorated ones.
Some reviewers mention the compartments don't secure together, so contents can spill if tipped or knocked over.
